backend/main.mo: Actor canister managing user profiles and per‑game statistics with access‑controlled queries and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping requested UI updates to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining OKLCH color system and light/dark UI foundations.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file bootstrapping the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level component handling navigation between home, Ludo, Chess, and Carrom screens.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button using Internet Identity with loading states and logout cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/home/HomeBannerC: Auto‑cycling 3‑slide banner carousel with navigation arrows and dot indicators using generated game images.
frontend/src/components/home/QuickPlayMe: Quick Play grid showing three image‑based game launch buttons with gradients and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/stats/StatsSumma: User stats card displaying per‑game totals and win rates for Ludo, Chess, and Carrom with loading states.
frontend/src/games/carrom/CarromBoardCan: Canvas component that draws the carrom board, pockets, and coins with shading based on game state.
Implements carrom physics, coin movement, collisions, pockets, and game state updates.
frontend/src/games/carrom/CarromScreen.t: UI screen managing carrom gameplay, shot controls, game initialization, and stat updates.
frontend/src/games/chess/ChessBoard.tsx: Renders an interactive chessboard with pieces, square selection, and visuals.
frontend/src/games/chess/chessRules.ts: Defines chess rules including move validation, board setup, check, and checkmate logic.
frontend/src/games/chess/ChessScreen.tsx: Manages chess gameplay flow, move handling, game state transitions, and stat tracking.
frontend/src/games/cricket/cricketEngine: Empty placeholder for the cricket game logic.
frontend/src/games/cricket/CricketScreen: Empty placeholder for the cricket game screen.
frontend/src/games/ludo/LudoBoard.tsx: Renders the Ludo board SVG, drawing home areas, track, finish zone, and pieces with selectable interaction.
frontend/src/games/ludo/ludoRules.ts: Implements Ludo game logic including initialization, dice rolls, movement rules, captures, and win detection.
frontend/src/games/ludo/LudoScreen.tsx: Provides the main Ludo game UI, handling game state, dice rolls, piece moves, and stat updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, providing login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update the logged-in user's game statistics via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and arcade-themed color variables plus UI utility classes including glass effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/screens/GameShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing a sticky header with back navigation, optional icons, actions, and a main content area.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Home screen displaying banners, quick play, stats, and a grid of selectable games with login integration.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters with hash support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, and container settings with plugins for typography, queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata outlining game features, known issues, required images, and current state version.
